hadith:
Pilgrims Prevented - Narrated by Al-Miswar -  Volume 3, Book 28, Number 38 

Allah's Apostle slaughtered (the Hadi) before he had his head shaved and then he ordered his Companions to do the same.
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Mu’akhir - الْمُؤَخِّرُ - The Delayer

The name Al Mu'akhir emphasizes the concept that Allah has the ultimate authority over what happens when, reminding believers that everything unfolds in the timing that is best according to divine wisdom. Its origin can be traced to the Arabic language and Islamic teachings, reflecting the understanding of God's nature as encompassing all aspects of time and existence.
verse:
At-Tahrim - The Prohibition - 66:5

Perhaps, if he were to divorce you ˹all˺, his Lord would replace you with better wives who are submissive ˹to Allah˺, faithful ˹to Him˺, devout, repentant, dedicated to worship and fasting—previously married or virgins.
